comment: Synthetic asymmetric decks (see corpus_live.rs 'Asymmetric synthetic decks' section): every stamping element + combinations in deliberately asymmetric configurations, live-compared against the pinned oracle by asymmetric_cases_match_oracle. selected_elements = the elements whose YPrim blocks are compared directly (the transposed-stamp catch). kind uses the same tolerance classes as solvable_now (micro|feeder|large). Cases with pending=true cover features the port does not implement yet (absorbed from the former gaps/ staging family, GAPS_PLAN.md section 3.1): the gate asserts the Rust engine errors loudly on them; the WP in each wp field flips pending=false when it ports the feature.

cases.note: Extended with cfilt: a series-tuned harmonic-filter bank (per-step R+XL) whose YPrim is a full series R+L+C branch off the pure-C diagonal at 60 Hz. Oracle-validated + feature-sensitive (dropping XL collapses it onto the pure-C stamp).

Boundaries: LineGeometry+WireData Carson full-asym Z/Yc (Line.pas geometry path, reduce=y Kron), 1-phase reduced spur, and the SymComponentsModel-only LongLineCorrection sinh(gamma*l)/(gamma*l) branch (Line.pas:1199/1369). Oracle: converged 5 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: LongLineCorrection yes->no changes Line.llong YPrim; swapping cond=1 wire changes Line.lgeo YPrim.

Boundaries: CNData concentric-neutral and TSData tape-shield reduced-Y (distinct Kron neutral elimination CN vs TS), asymmetric underground burial. Oracle: converged 2 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: CN strand count k 13->7 changes Line.lcn YPrim; TS TapeLayer 0.005->0.008 changes Line.lts YPrim.

Boundary: FMakeZFromSpacing (Line.pas:1183/1964) — the LineSpacing state machine, DISTINCT from the geometry path. lsp = overhead Spacing nconds=4 nphases=3 + distinct wires -> full-asym Carson Z/Yc via LoadSpacingAndWires + auto-reduce (NWires>NPhases, LineGeometry.pas:992); lspc = spacing+cable (TSCables+Wires) 1-phase spur, pins the spacing-with-cables sub-branch + gotRatingsAfterSpacingConds NormAmps/EmergAmps seed (Line.pas:1994). EarthModel DEFAULT (DERI) -> YPrim U1.2-STABLE (shares Get_Ze; the 658.5->658.853 SimpleCarson move does NOT touch this deck; do NOT flip to capi015). Also the U1.4 default-path no-change anchor (LineSpacing.Detailed/EqDist* + spacing-ratings defaults preserve 0.14.5 numerics). Oracle: converged 3 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: swapping the phase-2 wire ACSR_4-0->ACSR_556 changes Line.lsp YPrim.

Boundary: LongLineCorrection at f != BaseFrequency (Line.pas:1199-1287). Two SymComponentsModel long lines under Set LongLineCorrection=yes solved at the 5th harmonic (Set frequency=300, FreqMultiplier=5) -> per-frequency DoLongLine (X1_h=X1*f/base), the 0-seq DoLongLine sub-branch (FnPhases>1 and not PositiveSequence, r0<>r1), the LLC FreqMultiplier Z-assembly (:1269 vs :1287), and the LLC shunt-C branch (:1372). llh1 c1<>0; llh2 c1=0 (the G_h:=EPSILON no-skip case). Deviation from matrix P2 (mode=harmonics + monitor): a set-frequency snapshot with a DIRECT Line-YPrim compare is strictly stronger than the f32 harmonic monitor channel and needs no nonlinear-load-at-harmonic (linear shunt reactors, autotrans_gic pattern). Oracle: converged 2 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: LongLineCorrection yes->no changes both llh1/llh2 YPrims.

Boundary: Rg/Xg/Kxg ground-return frequency correction. Deck does NOT set LongLineCorrection (default FALSE), so it runs the non-LLC else branch (Line.pas:1281-1287), not the sibling LLC branch (:1262-1269); the two share the Xgmod formula but differ in the ZinvValues FreqMultiplier scaling. Explicit non-default Rg/Xg/rho solved at the 7th harmonic (Set frequency=420, FreqMultiplier=7). lgx (Xg<>0, Rg=0) fires the Xgmod=0.5*Kxg*ln(FreqMultiplier) branch; lgr (Rg<>0, Xg=0) fires the Rg*(FreqMultiplier-1) add — clean per-term isolation. WITNESSES the U1.2 inconsistency: Kxg deliberately KEEPS the 658.5 constant (upgrade ledger B2/D1) while SimpleCarson Get_Ze moves to 658.853; the SymComponentsModel path never calls Get_Ze, so this deck's YPrim must NOT move under U1.2 (INVARIANT regression, do NOT flip to capi015 — tracked in the upgrade ledger B2/D1, see the deck header). Oracle: converged 2 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: zeroing Rg/Xg (keeping f=420) changes both lgx/lgr YPrims.

Boundary: FullCarson EarthModel at SOLVE level (FLineConstants.Calc dispatch). Overhead geometry (reduce=y Kron, full-asym) under Set EarthModel=fullcarson — the only EarthModel with no prior live-solve deck (SimpleCarson=line_geometry/cable_asym, DERI=default). U1.2-INVARIANT control: U1.2 moves SimpleCarson Get_Ze 658.5->658.853 ONLY, FullCarson Get_Ze is unchanged, so this YPrim must NOT move (do NOT flip to capi015 — the complement of the Carson decks U1.2 flips). Oracle: converged 2 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: EarthModel fullcarson->Carson changes both lfc/lfcspur YPrims.

Boundaries: wye-delta step-up (delta-lead +30deg phase shift, opposite of transformer_asym.tdy's delta-wye lag) and delta-delta (both terminals ungrounded, common mode held by ppm_antifloat + a small wye cap pin per the family floor rule). Oracle: converged 2 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: twd conns wye-delta->wye-wye changes both YPrims.

Boundaries: Model 7 current-limited PQ (DoCurrentLimitedPQ clamp fires on the two phases sagged below Vminpu), Model 4 fixed-Q, Model 3 PV latched at a tight maxkvar. Oracle: converged 5 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: g7 model 7->1 changes the whole model (clamp active); g3 maxkvar 100->800 changes it (limit binding).

Boundaries (all wye-3ph): Storage IDLING state (Storage.pas:1410), PVSystem below %CutOut (P=0), PVSystem at the kvar clamp (tight kvarMax + WattPriority). Oracle: converged 2 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: idling->discharging, irradiance 0.05->0.9 (cutout), kvarMax 50->450 (clamp) each change the whole model.

Cross-element (midi): overhead Carson geometry -> CN cable -> delta-wye transformer -> unbalanced loads + TS 1-phase spur. Boundary: Carson/cable mutuals meet the transformer grounded-wye zero-sequence path across the assembled system Y (neutral-return coupling). Oracle: converged 3 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: adding a wdg-2 rneut/xneut ground impedance changes the whole-model fingerprint.

Load voltage-region state machine (Load.pas:1373/1433/1473/1658): a weak source + high-Z radial feeder sags far loads below Vminpu (interpolate_y95_ylow) and, at b3.2, below Vlowpu (const-Z Yeq), while a cap-boosted stub pushes bs above Vmaxpu (Yeq105 clamp). Models 1/3/5 (distinct interp paths) + 6/7 (yq_fixed) all fired off-normal. Oracle: converged 3 iters; bit-identical across 2 processes. Feature-sensitive: models 6/7 (interp/clamp) -> 1 changes the whole-model fingerprint.

The 330 MVA YNad1 unit from Test/AutoTrans/AutoAuto.dss + a 2-winding 115/69 auto. Oracle wdgcurrents (probe 2026-07-05, t2 spot value): non-zero live recompute - the READS_VTERMINAL family. WPG.15 Stage B: live-green.

Set frequency=0.1 snapshot - pins AutoTrans GICBuildYTerminal (the Solution.Frequency < 0.51 Hz resistance-only Y_Term branch) AND the Line GIC branch (ConvertZinvToPosSeqR, Line.pas:1297 - the near-ideal-source switch line is deliberate: at 0.1 Hz the deck state is zero-current, so no cancellation floor exists and every YPrim pins at micro tier). WPG.15: live-green.

The bus2 probes pin the GICsource edit-time splice: the oracle rewrites the named Line's Bus2 to the inserted GIC_<name> bus (proven 2026-07-05: buses gic_seg12/gic_seg23 appear; line.seg12.bus2 = gic_seg12).

All three GIC classes chained on a 6-substation 345 kV ring (33 nodes); the bus2 probes pin the GICsource splices. No async/both variants: the GIC classes have no shape reference or time-varying drive upstream.
